core_problem_solved: To provide the core, low-level streaming API for parsing (reading) and generating (writing) JSON. It serves as the high-performance foundation for the entire Jackson JSON processing ecosystem.
key_features: A fast and efficient streaming `JsonParser` for reading JSON tokens
A fast and efficient streaming `JsonGenerator` for writing JSON tokens
Defines the core JSON data model (`JsonNode`) for tree-based processing
Provides the base functionality upon which `jackson-databind` is built
era_and_niche: A fundamental and required core module for the Jackson library, which is the de facto standard for all JSON processing in the Java ecosystem.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is an actively maintained, essential component of the Jackson framework. It is typically used as a transitive dependency brought in by the higher-level **`com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind`** library, which provides convenient POJO data binding.
